Returns the Z coordinate of the ground below or above a point of the world. As with [TerrainX](TerrainX) this only differs from the Z you passed in when the terrain is rotated.
@param terrain The terrain.
@param world_x World X coordinate.
@param world_y World Y coordinate.
@param world_z World Z coordinate.
@returns The world Z coordinate of the ground at that position.
